{
  "established": "∀ n : Nat, n < 120 → (n ^ 3 + 5) % 67 ≠ 50",
  "proof_body": "by
  intro n hn
  have hNo : ∀ k : Fin 67, ((k.val ^ 3 + 5) % 67) ≠ 50 := by
    decide
  have h5 : 5 % 67 = 5 := by
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by decide : 5 < 67)
  have hpow : n ^ 3 % 67 = (n % 67) ^ 3 % 67 := by
    simpa using Nat.pow_mod n 3 67
  have hmod : (n ^ 3 + 5) % 67 = ((n % 67) ^ 3 + 5) % 67 := by
    simp [Nat.add_mod, h5, hpow]
  have hklt : n % 67 < 67 := Nat.mod_lt n (by decide : 0 < 67)
  have hk : ((n % 67) ^ 3 + 5) % 67 ≠ 50 := by
    simpa using hNo ⟨n % 67, hklt⟩
  intro hEq
  exact hk (by simpa [hmod] using hEq)",
  "report": "Reduced the goal modulo 67 (using Nat.pow_mod and Nat.add_mod) and used decidable finite checking over all residues modulo 67 to show (n^3+5) % 67 can never equal 50."
}

{

  "proof_body": "by
  intro a b
  cases b with
  | zero =>
      -- Counterexample: take b = 0. Then the goal is a % 0 < 0, which is impossible in Nat.
      sorry
  | succ b =>
      exact Nat.mod_lt a (Nat.succ b) (Nat.succ_ne_zero b)",
  "report": "The claim is false when b = 0 (there is no natural number strictly less than 0). The proof handles the succ case using Nat.mod_lt, but the b = 0 case is impossible and is left as sorry to make the file compile."
}

{

  "proof_body": "intro n hn
let m : Fin 120 := ⟨n, hn⟩
have hall : ∀ x : Fin 120, (2 * x.1 ^ 3 + x.1) % 61 ≠ 33 := by
  let P : Fin 120 → Prop := fun x => (2 * x.1 ^ 3 + x.1) % 61 ≠ 33
  have hbool : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 120)).all P = true := by
    native_decide
  have hmem : ∀ x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 120)), P x := (Finset.all_true_iff).1 hbool
  intro x
  exact hmem x (by simp)
simpa [m] using hall m",
  "report": "I reduced the goal to checking the inequality for all n < 120 by converting n to an element of Fin 120, then used native computation over the finite set (Finset.univ) to prove the remainder is never 33."
}
